clauses.quote: The three (3) options listed above shall not be provided to members who have not made a “substantial effort” (defined below) to secure a placement within DCPS.
Such Members shall be subject to separation on the 66th calendar day following the effective day in which they were excessed.
DCPS shall notify Teachers in writing of the process for selecting one of the three options and for notifying DCPS of the selection.

Excessed permanent status Teachers who qualify and volunteer for the DCPS Performance-Based Compensation System shall have sixty (60) calendar days following the effective date of the excess to secure another placement in DCPS under mutual consent.
clauses.subject_text: Excessed permanent status Teachers who qualify and volunteer for the DCPS Performance-Based Compensation System

clauses.quote: DCPS shall offer multiple hiring opportunities (e.g., job fairs, interviews, access to job postings, etc.) for all such Teachers during the sixty (60) calendar day period.
All such Teachers who are unable to secure a placement under mutual consent during the sixty (60) calendar day period shall be subject to separation from DCPS on the 61st calendar day.
clauses.subject_text: All such Teachers who are unable to secure a placement under mutual consent during the sixty (60) calendar day period

clauses.quote: All such Teachers shall not have access to the options described in Section 4.5.5.3.
